_readme: Altitude facts shown on the ruler. Each was checked against the source on the date given. 'past' completes the sentence 'You climbed past ...' on the summit screen.

facts.text: The Dead Sea shore is about 440 m below this line, the lowest land on Earth
La Paz, the highest seat of government, about 3,650 m
facts.past: the highest seat of government on Earth

facts.text: El Alto, the highest big city, about 4,000 m
facts.past: the highest big city on Earth

facts.text: Daocheng Yading, the highest airport, about 4,411 m
Trains cross the Tanggula Pass in Tibet at about 5,072 m
La Rinconada, Peru, the highest town, up to about 5,100 m
Everest South Base Camp, about 5,364 m
Tiny jumping spiders live up here, about 6,700 m
A bar-headed goose was tracked flying at about 7,290 m
The death zone starts at about 8,000 m. Too little oxygen to stay
facts.past: the start of the death zone

facts.text: On top, each breath holds less than a third of the oxygen at sea level
Planes cruise higher than this, at about 9,400 to 11,600 m
